newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - HFS Inc started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - HFS Inc started with buy.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said analyst Jeff Kessler started coverage HFS Inc with a buy rating on Friday and a 12-year price target of $75.
-- Shares were off 7/8 to 53-1/8 amid market weakness. The Standard & Poor's 500 Index was off more than a percent.

-- Kessler said, "We believe the critical challenge facing HFS in cross-selling the services of one franchisee to another will be made much easier by CUC (International Inc ), the expertise of which is marketing to consumers. The new challenge will be maintaining rapid growth in a such a large company."
-- HFS and CUC announced earier this week that they were merging.
